rationale: Real BingX BTC-USDT/1h retention as of 2026-07-26 is ~819.9 days (19,678 bars, zero internal gaps, earliest 2024-04-27T10:00:00Z, latest 2026-07-26T07:00:00Z) -- confirmed by a real backfill.py run against the live production endpoint, see .planning/sr-f-risk-management-and-1h-variant.md. A separate config from configs/research/holdout.json (which is 15m-scoped) because python/research/holdout.py's loaders read symbol/interval from whichever config path they're given -- load_research_klines/load_holdout_klines already accept an explicit holdout_config_path override, so a second config file is the minimal, no-code-change way to give the 1h dataset its own cutoff, rather than overloading one config with two symbol/interval identities. Cutoff reserves the trailing 150 days (3,600 bars, 2026-02-26T08:00:00Z onward) as holdout: 150/819.9 = 18.3%, within the 15-25%-of-available-data framing established by configs/research/holdout.json's own rationale (the 15m config additionally satisfied a 'fixed 30-45 day' framing specific to that thin, ~252-day dataset; at this much greater 1h depth the percentage framing is the operative one, and a 150-day holdout is still a materially-sized, genuine final check, not a token one). Leaves 16,078 bars (~669.9 days) of research data -- enough for many more walk-forward folds than the 15m dataset's 3 at proportionally-scaled provisional windows (train=2,160/validate=720/step=720 1h-bars, i.e. the same ~90/30/30-day shape as the 15m provisional defaults); see the planning doc for the real fold count actually achieved.
